channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kevin Garnett | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kevin Garnett from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Kevin Garnett, Caleb Wilson
item.description:
Draymond Green on people calling him a idiot for saying Caleb Wilson’s floor is Kevin Garnett:

“I said that with all due respect to Kevin Garnett, but just saying, yo, this kid can be that special. So if I say Kevin Garnett’s the floor, by no mean am I dimming Kevin Garnett’s light. I’m not capable of dimming Kevin Garnett’s light. He’s Kevin Garnett. What I’m saying is I think this kid can be that good.”

Draymond Green on Kevin Garnett, Caleb Wilson, Jul 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Dirk Nowitzki, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
He's joined by his brothers Thanasis and Alex, who played together in the latest Bucks game, and he congratulates them, beaming with pride, but also looking worn out and tired.) Antetokounmpo:

“This is why you have conversations with all-time greats like KG (Kevin Garnett). Dirk (Nowitzki) was in the same position, and chose to stay. We’ll see. We’ll see what’s going to happen.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Dirk Nowitzki, Kevin Garnett, Apr 7, 2026. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Karl-Anthony Towns on Kevin Garnett's jersey retirement:

“Yeah, I'll be there. I'll be there. ... It's a long time coming. I've been saying he needs a statue in the front. Step by step. I'm just happy he's getting back into the Timberwolves family and he's feeling welcomed.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Kevin Garnett, Dec 23, 2025. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Ray Allen on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“I think, for the most part, time has passed, and it’s that idea of thought that as you age, you make amends with your past follies and you forgive old enemies [Paul Pierce and Kevin Garnett],”

Ray Allen on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett, Oct 24, 2024. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Sam Cassell on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“It’s ain’t about making conference finals as a member of the Celtics, the coaching staff and the players. It’s all about winning the championship. That’s the tradition in Boston — win the championship. Playing for guys who won previously for us, Kevin Garnett, Paul Pierce, Russell, Cousy, Maxwell, the history goes on. It’s about them. That’s the thing that our guys have to understand. It’s a pride thing.”

Sam Cassell on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett, Jul 11, 2023. Source: Celtics Blog.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Dirk Nowitzki, DeMar DeRozan, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
Casey on Bogey as potential All-Star:

“I hope people don’t look at our record as a rebuilding team & punish him. To me, Bogey’s an All-Star. I’ve coached a lot of offensive players in my career — Nowitzki, DeRozan, Kevin Garnett. Offensively, he’s right up there with those guys.”

Dwane Casey on Dirk Nowitzki, DeMar DeRozan, Kevin Garnett, Dec 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Stephon Marbury on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“It was solely I didn’t want to spend seven years of my life in Minnesota. People were like, ‘Oh, you jealous of Kevin Garnett because of the money he made.’You guys don’t make no sense. The rule is the rule. I got the max contract. This has nothing to do with money. I didn’t want to spend seven years of my life there, period,”

Stephon Marbury on Kevin Garnett, Nov 11, 2022. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Grant Williams on Al Jefferson, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
Williams explained that Brown having his name mentioned as the potential centerpiece in a deal for Durant just shows how great the Celtics star is.

“It kind of shows how valuable he is. The fact that, top-10 player in the world, you’re the focal point. It’s one of those things, I remember, back in the day with Al Jefferson and KG [Kevin Garnett].It’s one of those things where you’re like, ‘oh dang, Al Jefferson.’ It’s not even like a difference,”

Grant Williams on Al Jefferson, Kevin Garnett, Aug 13, 2022. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Moussa Diabate on Tim Thomas, Kevin Garnett, Serge Ibaka, Pascal Siakam, Bam Adebayo, Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
Moussa Diabaté:

“Over the years, I’ll say a lot of Bam Adebayo, Pascal Siakam, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Kevin Garnett. Those are four players that I’ve really looked up to. I watch a little bit of everyone. Tim Thomas, I don’t know if you know him, but I watch a little bit of him. Serge Ibaka, I watch him from back when he was in OKC; that’s another big one. Just players like that – all-around big 4s and centers who are able to move their feet, guard on the perimeter, be versatile and make a two-way impact.”

Moussa Diabate on Tim Thomas, Kevin Garnett, Serge Ibaka, Pascal Siakam, Bam Adebayo, Jaren Jackson Jr, Jul 9, 2022. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
All of the young players on the 2007-08 team – Rondo, Powe, Perkins, Allen, Gabe Pruitt, Glen Davis – moved on with the knowledge they had just been anointed by a legend

“It was crazy. There were times I would catch myself saying man, that’s Kevin Garnett,”

Kendrick Perkins on Kevin Garnett, Mar 13, 2022. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
Rivers said during Thursday’s shootaround.

“I’ve been in this league too long. And I always go back to [the Celtics’ 2008 NBA championship team.] Kevin [Garnett] and I talk about it all the time. I remember the first year [2007-08] during training camp [with the Celtics] we had a meeting and they were saying, ‘Man, we have to get it together. This might not be the year. But by next year, we might…’ I said, ‘Next year? Are you guys kidding me? Next year one of you can get hurt.’“I know it’s short. I know it’s going to be hard to get it together. But having said that, the time is always now.”

Doc Rivers on Kevin Garnett, Feb 18, 2022. Source: The Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Cedric Maxwell on Kevin Garnett, Bill Fitch
item.description:
former Celtics forward Cedric Maxwell told the Boston Globe on Thursday.

“He was Kevin Garnett before Kevin Garnett. Kevin always said it was us against them, and with Bill Fitch it was us against them.”

Cedric Maxwell on Kevin Garnett, Bill Fitch, Feb 4, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
In an appearance this week on Draymond Green’s podcast, retired ex-NBA swingmanMatt Barnes revealed that Garnett nearly got traded to the Golden State Warriors in 2007 instead of the Celtics.

“We were supposed to trade J-Rich [Jason Richardson] and our pick to get Kevin Garnett,”

Matt Barnes on Kevin Garnett, Dec 26, 2021. Source: Yardbarker.com.

item.title: Joakim Noah on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“I realized I was taking this energy -- F--- this dude, f--- that dude -- and carrying it around every day. [Garnett] made me realize, keep that s--- on the court.”

Joakim Noah on Kevin Garnett, Oct 29, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Patrick Ewing, Kevin Garnett, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Doc Rivers on Joel Embiid:

“Kevin Garnett was a four. I played with Patrick Ewing. I would combine those two together and make a Joel in some cases because he has a little bit of both of those.”

Doc Rivers on Patrick Ewing, Kevin Garnett, Joel Embiid, Jan 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Jalen Smith on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Maryland's Jalen Smith on modeling his game after Kevin Garnett:

“He was insane on the court. That's how I try to carry myself, just be insane.”

Jalen Smith on Kevin Garnett, Nov 12, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“That’s something I would like to do while I’m here with the Celtics. I’m definitely inspired by Kevin Garnett. I think we’re totally two different people, we play two different positions, but I would like to model my approach after his, and hopefully we will down the road be looked at as similar.”

Jaylen Brown on Kevin Garnett, Jul 2, 2020. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“I talked to Kevin Garnett on the day he went into the Hall of Fame and we had a long talk, but one of the things he actually said is, ‘Man, I can’t wait for the playoffs,’”

Doc Rivers on Kevin Garnett, Apr 9, 2020. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Wyc Grousbeck on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
Tom Westerholm:Wyc Grousbeck on Kevin Garnett in a statement from the team:

“He will always be one of my very favorite Celtics.… He was the true embodiment of Celtics pride.”

Wyc Grousbeck on Kevin Garnett, Feb 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @Tom_NBA.

item.title: Jarrett Allen on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“What happened [before] didn’t change. … I know we had the whole [Kevin Garnett] thing — that’s one of my favorite players — but this is a whole other level of what’s going to happen, or could happen. It’s going to be interesting. It’s going to be interesting. That’s all I can say.”

Jarrett Allen on Kevin Garnett, Jul 4, 2019. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Giannis Antetokoumpo on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
Antetokounmpo points to how Kobe Bryant and Kevin Garnett didn’t have relationships with their competitors back in their playing days.

“Was Kobe every close with his uh…Was Kevin Garnett ever close with the guys he played against? I think just being competitive and I’m going to play against them and I’ll see them in the playoffs with many more years to come,”

Giannis Antetokoumpo on Kevin Garnett, Mar 28, 2019. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“I think (Garnett) is like a proud big brother as much as anything else. He's liked the way Dre has been playing defensively, rebounding, running the floor, playing at an All-Star level. I think KG wanted to reinforce some of the things he had talked to him about and he also did some things for TNT.”

Dwane Casey on Kevin Garnett, Nov 18, 2018. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: David Fizdale on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“He talked about his rookie year when [Kevin Garnett] and them was just kicking his butt and how he would never beat himself up but he would take it, he would learn from it, and then he would put it into his workouts,”

David Fizdale on Kevin Garnett, Oct 11, 2018. Source: Bergen Record.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“Your dad, [Doc Rivers], was an NBA coach, you've been able to work out with Paul Pierce and [Kevin Garnett] and Ray Allen and all that. We felt like you had the upperhand. He had the NBA socks when we were playing. We were thinking about all of this stuff. You had access to all this stuff and we didn't. We were kind of envious of it. His game was like super far advanced from everybody else; his handle, his floater, everything. In a way, we were like 'man, this dude.' We were kind of jealous of him for a little bit.”

Bradley Beal on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Kevin Garnett, Sep 28, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Ray Allen on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
Allen's first reference to the Celtics drew loud cheers from fans seated in the balcony.

“In my 12th year, I paired up with a couple of Hall of Famers in Paul Pierce and Kevin Garnett,”

Ray Allen on Paul Pierce, Kevin Garnett, Sep 8, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jason Terry on Paul Pierce, Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“Then, for the next 15 minutes, he did something I’ve never seen from Dirk Nowitzki, Kevin Garnett, Jason Kidd or Paul Pierce. And he was working on defensive coverages. No one works on defense by themselves. This kid is way ahead of the curve.”

Jason Terry on Paul Pierce, Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Kevin Garnett, Feb 15, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Ray Allen, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
in Boston started so well … Doc Rivers:

“I thought they were ready, for one. I thought, No. 2, Kevin (Garnett), was the key to it. The problem when you have three scorers is somebody is always going to get less. Two guys are probably going to get the same or a little less and one guy is going to get a lot less. You can look at Miami, it was (Chris) Bosh. With us, at times it was Ray (Allen), at times it was KG, but I thought KG was key because early on he literally gave up his offensive game. He just said ‘I’ll be the defensive captain, you guys do all the scoring.’”

Doc Rivers on Ray Allen, Kevin Garnett, Nov 10, 2017. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: LeBron James on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Rajon Rondo, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
LeBron James:

“So, it's going to be very challenging. Those guys are going to challenge me. They're going to challenge our ballclub. This is a high-powered teamand I've played against some other (stiff competition). I've played against Ray (Allen), KG (Kevin Garnett), Paul (Pierce), (Rajon) Rondo and Doc (Rivers). So, it's going to be very challenging not only on me mentally, but on our ballclub and on our franchise.”

LeBron James on Paul Pierce, Ray Allen, Doc Rivers, Rajon Rondo, Kevin Garnett, May 28, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Kevin Garnett
item.description:
“[Garnett] was like, 'If you and [James] Posey were still playing, I would come.'”

Tyronn Lue on Kevin Garnett, May 2, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Gerald Green on Kevin Garnett, Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Gerald Green:

“(Isaiah Thomas) almost kind of had, like -- I don't want to say (such) a big thing -- but he almost kind of had like a Kevin Garnett effect on this organization.”

Gerald Green on Kevin Garnett, Isaiah Thomas, Apr 13, 2017. Source: Booth Newspapers.
